methodology.Fees: Total swap fees paid by traders — each pool's fee rate applied to its swap volume.
methodology.Revenue: The 20% share of swap fees the protocol keeps and sends to the Ref DAO treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 20% treasury cut of swap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 80% of swap fees earned by liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Sum of 24h swap volume across all Ref/Rhea pools on NEAR (classic, stable, rated and concentrated-liquidity), skipping any pool whose 24h volume exceeds 15x its liquidity as likely wash trading.

Value of tokens sent through the Allbridge Classic bridge, counted once on the source chain at the amount bridged after the fee. Transfers sent from Solana, Near and Stellar are not tracked since 2026-08-31.
methodology.Fees: Bridge fee users pay in the transferred token on each send from the source chain. Sends from Solana, Near and Stellar are not tracked since 2026-08-31.
methodology.Revenue: 20% of the bridge fees collected on sends, kept by the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol receives 20% of the collected bridge fee.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 80% of the collected bridge fee is used for rewards to the stakers

Fees.Bridge Fees: Fees charged to users for each cross-chain token transfer on the source chain.

Revenue.Bridge Fees: 20% of bridge fees kept by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees: 20% of bridge fees collected by the protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees: 80% of bridge fees distributed as rewards to stakers who provide liquidity.

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.Volume: Value of the tokens swapped on VEAX, from the swap events of the veax.near contract. Each swap is counted once, on its wNEAR, stablecoin, ETH, BTC or stNEAR side; swaps between two other tokens and the 2026-10-31 exploit are excluded.

methodology.Volume: All deposits and withdrawals into currently ongoing auctions
methodology.Fees: Fees from deposits (0.5%), withdrawals (2%) and launch fee (2%)
methodology.Revenue: All fees from deposits and launch fees are for the protocol
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: There is a 2% withdrawal fee, which gets redistributed to all depositors of the same auction and referrals (shares 50% of deposit fee)
